answer: The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, capped per identity per epoch, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Every claim climbs the nebula of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the delta re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. By the ivory of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
